description: I do not have to find or chase myself #bigsisteradvice #designyourlife #PersonalGrowth
transcript: life became lighter when I realized I don't need to chase anything I do not have to go find myself the truth will reveal itself along the process and over time it is my responsibility to edit fine-tune and refine but it is not for me to chase my identity is rooted and the more that I lean into understanding and acceptance in that I'm free it makes me free of carrying baggage that's too heavy creating more time to spend with myself in the present moment rather than looking at the past or being so hard-pressed to chase the future who I am now is someone who is rooted in design and creating
